subject: Leaf Blower Use Ordinance
overview: The committee met to review a draft ordinance to regulate leaf blower noise, seasonal usage, and the long-term phase-out of gas-powered equipment. No final vote was taken on the ordinance itself, but the council approved motions to incorporate departmental feedback and host a stakeholder meeting.

items.title: Review of Proposed Leaf Blower Ordinance
items.summary: Councilors discussed draft regulations focusing on seasonal use windows, decibel limits, and potential exemptions for municipal properties.

items.title: Economic Development Outreach Report
items.summary: The Economic Development Director detailed outreach efforts to 569 local businesses and landscaping companies to solicit feedback on the proposal.

items.title: Building Department Enforcement Review
items.summary: The Building Commissioner highlighted enforcement challenges, including the necessity of staff training for decibel meters and projected overtime costs for weekend monitoring.

items.title: Stakeholder and Public Testimony
items.summary: Landscaping business owners and the Chamber of Commerce voiced concerns regarding equipment costs and requested that seasonal limits be adjusted to accommodate early spring and late fall cleanups.

items.title: Action on Amendments and Further Study
items.summary: Approved motions to increase the 'de minimis' use exemption to 15 minutes and to formally invite landscaping stakeholders to a subcommittee meeting for further collaboration. The committee also approved a motion requesting that relevant departments provide revised language and feedback for the next draft.
